summary: Build practical ransomware recovery plans, test backups, and improve restore decisions. Train your team with hands-on exercises and templates.
lede: Ransomware readiness and recovery planning prepares IT, security, and continuity professionals to organize containment and restore critical services after an attack. They assess service dependencies, set recovery time and recovery point objectives, and validate isolated backup and restore workflows. They also develop response playbooks and tabletop tests to coordinate restoration, communications, and improvement actions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who must turn ransomware readiness and recovery planning into practical operating capability.
outcomes: Recovery Time And Point Objective Analysis
prerequisites: Participants should have working knowledge of IT operations, backup and restore concepts, and basic cyber incident response terminology. Familiarity with business continuity planning, service dependencies, or infrastructure support is helpful, but no programming is required. If you already manage recovery runbooks, backup platforms, or incident coordination, you will be able to apply the course more directly.
